contracts.boundary: One local command rebinds the per-change declaration to a reviewed base and validates the shape the acceptance run enforces: the base resolves to a real commit, is an ancestor of HEAD, matches the declaration's base field, and declared files exactly cover diff(base, HEAD). The helper never connects to the network and never edits anything but the declaration file.
contracts.assertions: resolveBaseRef uses --verify so a ref that names no commit in the object database fails with a prefixed message; a base outside HEAD's ancestry fails with a named detail while unrelated git failures keep their cause; --apply validates the rebinding manifest in memory before anything is written, so a structurally invalid declaration never reaches disk; --apply rewrites only the declaration base in place, once, landing the bytes through a same-directory temp file rename, refuses a rewrite whose bytes would exceed the 256 KiB cap the validator enforces without touching the on-disk declaration, and is idempotent; coverage reports file set differences in both directions without guessing; the CLI exits 0 with a report only when the declaration matches the requested base and its file list exactly covers the candidate diff, exits 1 with a report naming each uncovered file, exits 1 without a report when the base cannot resolve or operands are malformed, and prints usage on malformed operands; validation without --apply never writes.
